title: Blue Light Illumination Effects on bPACy and WT Organisms
summary: This cluster describes the effects of blue light illumination on two organisms, bPACy and wild-type (WT). The organism bPACy has lower abundance of Pde1 and higher abundance of AMP compared to WT. WT organisms are exposed to both blue light and darkness, and harvested in 0.9% NaCl. The chemical LFM is incubated in blue light illumination and shifted to darkness. The method or tool cAMP regulates several genes and proteins, including Cyr1, GCN4, PKA, and Pde1, and increases the production of β-carotene and Cordycepin.
